name: Elemental Aid
summary: A shaman is asked to investigate the quilboar gathering in Razorfen Kraul. The earth warns of a ritual, and the elements need aid against those who abuse their power.

sections.title: The Earth’s Warning
sections.body: The earth carries a warning to a shaman: the quilboar are gathering in Razorfen Kraul for a ritual of terrible power. Your task is to investigate their kraul and return with information on their plans. The elements lend you their aid, and now they need yours.

faq.q: What does the earth warn about?
faq.answer: The earth warns that the quilboar are gathering for a ritual of terrible power.
The quilboar are gathering in Razorfen Kraul.

faq.q: Why does the shaman need to help the elements?
faq.answer: The elements help the shaman, and the shaman is asked to repay that aid by helping them against those who abuse their power.
You are asked to investigate Razorfen Kraul and bring back information on the quilboar's plans.
The request comes from a speaker who calls you a shaman and says the elements need help.

angles.text: As a shaman, you have mastered the elements, and this request calls on you to repay their aid.
